item.title: github: Rule insights dashboard generally available
item.description:
The rule insights dashboard is now generally available for both repositories and organizations. It provides a visual, high-level view of how GitHub evaluates and enforces repository rules.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: Announcing: Aspire 13.5 has shipped
item.description:
Aspire 13.5 has shipped. This release refreshes the dashboard and aspire.dev, expands the Interaction Service, adds cross-scope Azure references and persistent Kubernetes volumes, and introduces live terminals in the apphost.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Track organization code quality trends
item.description:
GitHub’s organization-level Code Quality dashboard now has a Trends tab. It shows code quality changes across repositories over time instead of only a point-in-time view.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot impact dashboard adds a return on investment section
item.description:
The Copilot impact dashboard now includes a “Potential return on investment” section. It links Copilot spend to pull request output to help estimate ROI.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New Copilot usage metrics impact dashboard
item.description:
GitHub released a new Copilot metrics impact dashboard for enterprise administrators and organization owners. It is meant to help them report Copilot impact using usage metrics and related data.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New pull requests dashboard is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub’s refreshed pull requests dashboard is now generally available at github.com/pulls. It provides a single place to track, prioritize, and act on pull requests that need attention.

  • Source: GitHub
